provisions.title: To commit computer fraud
provisions.conduct: Acquiring a financial benefit by fraud through a computer, including from the payment of any bill, the balance of another person's account, or an ATM card. The amount obtained is recoverable.
provisions.penalty: fine not exceeding one hundred thousand Rupees or imprisonment not exceeding two years or both
provisions.basis: 13 payment identifiers (0119.0625.987456, 0501-0198765432 and 0501-9012345678) appear alongside 9 money values (NPR 1,500, NPR 200 and NPR 25,000) in the same case, evidencing a financial benefit moving through a payment rail.

provisions.title: Publication of illegal materials in electronic form
provisions.conduct: Publishing or displaying material in electronic media, including on the internet, which is prohibited by prevailing law or is contrary to public morality or decent behaviour.
provisions.penalty: fine not exceeding one hundred thousand Rupees or imprisonment not exceeding five years or both
provisions.basis: threat intelligence flagged 6 indicators in this case; the evidence carries 10 web addresses (eSewa-cashback-offer.xyz and esewa-cashback-offer.xyz), i.e. material published in electronic form.

provisions.title: Punishment to the person who abets to commit computer related offence
provisions.conduct: Abetting another to commit an offence under the Act, or attempting or being involved in a conspiracy to commit one.
provisions.penalty: fine not exceeding fifty thousand Rupees or imprisonment not exceeding six months or both, depending on the degree of the offence
provisions.basis: campaign CAMP_CASE_665F85EBBC_01 groups 5 evidence items by shared indicators, which evidences coordinated activity rather than a single isolated act.

provisions.title: Punishment to the Accomplice
provisions.conduct: Assisting another to commit an offence under the Act, or acting as an accomplice by any means.
provisions.penalty: one half of the punishment for which the principal is liable
provisions.basis: campaign CAMP_CASE_665F85EBBC_01 evidences coordination across 5 evidence items. Where more than one person acted, anyone who assisted is liable to one half of the principal's punishment.

provisions.title: Punishment for illegal use of trade-marks
provisions.citation: Section 19, Patent, Design and Trade Mark Act, 2022 (1965)
provisions.conduct: Using a trade-mark that is not registered to the user, using one whose registration has been cancelled, or otherwise using a registered mark without authority (s.18B).
provisions.penalty: fine not exceeding one hundred thousand Rupees, and confiscation of articles and goods connected with the offence, as per its gravity
provisions.basis: brand marks were detected in the evidence (Facebook, Google, Khalti and 5 more) across 4 evidence items. Where the material was not published by the mark's owner, its use is unauthorised. Registration and authority are matters of record to be confirmed.

provisions.penalty: confiscation of the computer, computer system, disks, software or other accessory devices used
